In the current one-sided packet, e5 square peel plus completed B09 product half-Riesz gives D(Q)<=8/sqrt(|a sigma|)<=(8/s_3(A)) rho/|a|.

corrections_retained: No law-uniform pointwise quadratic-phase decay from density caps alone.

Small matrix coefficients are not uniformly small random quadratic perturbations under arbitrary unbounded inputs.
